verdict_convention: Judge pre-inversion yes/no. Negated EF/AQ items record whether the named flaw is present, not the post-inversion score.

identifies_the_mechanism.rationale: Root cause names unlimited 1s retries with no backoff/jitter on 64 shared slots.

separates_trigger_from_cause.rationale: Gateway 03:11–03:17 is the trigger; the retry policy explains the ~38× duration.

grounded_in_evidence.rationale: Cites at least two of worker-config.yaml, startup retry line, m-8841207, and retry_share_pct.

rules_out_the_decoys.rationale: v2.8.1 is rejected as log-format-only with a healthy queue from 02:47 to 03:11.

separates_contributing_factors.rationale: Email-only 500k alert, missing lag/slot alerts, and no DLQ are distinct from the retry policy.

uncertainty_is_genuine.rationale: Asks about duplicates, drain fate, or customer count, which the pack cannot settle.

bounds_the_amplification.rationale: An action caps attempts and/or adds backoff, DLQ, retry budget, or a gateway breaker.

closes_the_detection_gap.rationale: An action pages on lag, slot saturation, or re-routes the queue-depth alert.

actions_are_actionable.rationale: Actions name config keys, alert routes, or DLQ with a done-when.

actions_trace_to_findings.rationale: Actions follow the retry-policy, detection, or shared-slot findings.

proposes_unsupported_work.rationale: Does not propose rolling back v2.8.1, replacing the vendor, or resizing notifications-db.

blames_the_deploy.rationale: v2.8.1 is mentioned only as a rejected hypothesis.

treats_db_cpu_as_cause.rationale: notifications-db CPU 86% is treated as a symptom of retry volume.

asserts_unsupported_cause.rationale: Cause is the unbounded retry policy supported by the evidence.

misstates_a_fact.rationale: Gateway window 03:11–03:17, 07:03 resolution, 64 slots, and unlimited/1000ms match the files.

invents_evidence.rationale: Cited logs, config, and metrics exist in /app/evidence.
